messages.author: f1b4fa1e87486936
messages.subject: How to export multilocus lineages data (including only one individual from the particular MLL) to genalex file with poppr
parts: In order to make the genetic diversity and genetic structure analyses performed in Arlequin and Structure program at the genet level that is, including only one individual from the particular MLL.

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] How to export multilocus lineages data (including only one individual from the particular MLL) to genalex file with poppr
parts:
Hello,

You can do this in three steps:

1. subset your data with the clonecorrect function
2. export to genalex format with write.genalex
3. open the exported data in excel and use genalex to convert to Arlequin or Structure format. 

Sent from my iPhone
